title.en: A law along one run, under a relation
title.zh: 沿一个运行、在一个关系之下的规律

statement.en: Under an equivalence, a law admits a run's steps up to a step exactly where steps alike under it, by the same move, end alike, and failure persists. Projection, changing coupling and fixed conditions are its readings; the image is exact exactly where alike configurations match steps.
statement.zh: 在一个等价关系之下，规律容许一个运行到某步为止的各步，恰在经它相同、动作相同的步终于相同之处，失败持续。投影、改变的耦合与固定条件是其读法；像恰在相同的配置相互匹配步之处精确。

laws.en: Where a relation is an equivalence, some process going alike under it admits a run's steps before a step exactly where any two of them from related configurations, by the same move, reach related configurations. The witness is the record read under the relation; the forward direction needs no equivalence.
laws.zh: 关系是等价关系时，某个在它之下同去的过程容许一个运行在某步之前的各步，恰在其中任两步从相关的配置、以相同的动作，到达相关的配置之处。见证是在该关系下读出的记录；正方向不需要等价。

laws.en: Consistency up to a step holds at every earlier step, so once no such process admits the steps it admits none later; a process going alike under the relation makes every run consistent; through equal projections the criterion is the one along one run through a projection.
laws.zh: 到某步为止的一致在每个更早的步都成立，所以一旦没有这样的过程容许那些步，以后也没有；在该关系下同去的过程使每个运行一致；经相等的投影，这判据就是沿一个运行经投影的判据。

laws.en: Some determined process on a description admits a run's steps before a step, read through the projection, exactly where any two of them from configurations alike under it, by the same move, reach configurations alike under it. The witness is the record read through the projection: it admits those steps, every process admitting them admits its steps, and it is determined exactly where they are consistent.
laws.zh: 某个描述上的确定过程容许一个运行在某步之前经投影读出的各步，恰在其中任两步从经投影相同的配置、以相同的动作，到达经投影相同的配置之处。见证是经投影读出的记录：它容许这些步，容许它们的每个过程都容许它的步，并恰在它们一致处是确定的。

laws.en: Consistency up to a step holds at every earlier step, so where no determined process on the description admits the steps before a step, none admits them before any later one. Through the identity at every step the criterion is Becoming.Unfolding's consistency of a history, of which exists_law_iff is the law.
laws.zh: 到某步为止的一致在每个更早的步都成立，所以在没有描述上的确定过程容许某步之前各步之处，也没有一个容许任何更晚步之前的各步。经恒等投影、在每一步，这判据就是 Becoming.Unfolding 中历史的一致，exists_law_iff 是其规律。

laws.en: Where configurations alike under the projection go alike, every run is consistent through it at every step; the converse fails: a run staying at one configuration of a process allowing every step is consistent through the identity, and the process does not go alike. Switching's run is inconsistent through the projection; its missing state law is Switching.no_state_law of Becoming.Mechanism.
laws.zh: 经投影相同的配置同去之处，每个运行在每一步经它一致；反之不然：在允许每一步的过程中停在一个配置的运行经恒等一致，而过程不同去。Switching 的运行经投影不一致；它缺少状态规律，即 Becoming.Mechanism 的 Switching.no_state_law。

laws.en: With dependences read off the configuration, two configurations are alike in what a formation couples into when the levels at each, through the dependence it has there, admit it alike and the conditions it observes stand alike. This is an equivalence, so some process going alike in it admits a run's steps before a step exactly where the occasions it couples alike, by the same move, lead to occasions it couples alike. Fixed conditions are the instance.
laws.zh: 依赖从配置读出时，两个配置在一个形成所耦合者上相同，当各自的水平经它在那里的依赖同样地容许它、且它所观察的条件水平相同。这是等价关系，所以某个在其上同去的过程容许一个运行在某步之前的各步，恰在它耦合相同的场合以相同的动作通向它耦合相同的场合之处。固定条件是其实例。

laws.en: Along a run this is the relation between two steps each read through its own step's dependence. Web.AlikeThrough read at one step, between the levels standing at two steps, is the coupling with the dependence of that step held fixed; where the dependences at the two steps compared are that step's, it is the changing coupling.
laws.zh: 沿运行，这是两步各经本步依赖读出之间的关系。在某一步读出的 Web.AlikeThrough，在两步所立的水平之间，是把该步依赖固定的耦合；所比较两步的依赖就是该步的依赖之处，它就是改变的耦合。

laws.en: Consistency reads a relation only on the run's configurations up to the step, so where a formation's dependences up to it are those of one step, the run is consistent under the changing coupling exactly where it is under the coupling fixed at that step.
laws.zh: 一致只读关系在运行到该步为止的配置上的部分，所以一个形成到该步为止的依赖都是某一步的依赖之处，运行在改变的耦合下一致，恰在它在固定于那一步的耦合下一致之处。

laws.en: With fixed conditions, two configurations are alike in what a formation couples into when their levels admit it alike and the conditions it observes stand alike; this is an equivalence, exactly Web.AlikeThrough on the runs read through the conditions, between two runs at a step and between two steps of one run. So some process going alike in what the formation couples into admits a run's steps exactly where the occasions it couples alike, by the same move, lead to occasions it couples alike.
laws.zh: 在固定条件下，两个配置在一个形成所耦合者上相同，当它们的水平同样地容许它、且它所观察的条件水平相同；这是等价关系，恰是经条件读出的运行上的 Web.AlikeThrough，无论是两个运行在同一步之间，还是一个运行的两步之间。所以某个在该形成所耦合者上同去的过程容许一个运行的各步，恰在它耦合相同的场合以相同的动作通向它耦合相同的场合之处。

laws.en: In Unseen the process is determined, and a formation depending on one level and observing nothing couples the run's first two steps alike while by the same move they lead to configurations it couples apart: the level it does not couple into decides, and no law holds at its coupling along the run. Observing that level, the run is consistent at every step.
laws.zh: 在 Unseen 中过程是确定的，一个依于一个水平而不观察任何东西的形成把运行的前两步耦合为相同，而以相同的动作它们通向它耦合为不同的配置：它不耦合的水平起决定作用，沿该运行在其耦合上没有规律。观察那个水平，运行在每一步都一致。

laws.en: In Changing, one level rising by one each step, the process is determined. A dependence dissolving across the first step leaves the run consistent at every step under the changing coupling, and inconsistent at step 2 under the coupling fixed at the start. A dependence forming across the first step leaves the coupling fixed at the start consistent at every step, and the changing coupling inconsistent at step 3.
laws.zh: 在 Changing 中，一个水平每步升一，过程是确定的。在第一步消散的依赖使运行在改变的耦合下每步一致，而在开始时固定的耦合下于第 2 步不一致。在第一步形成的依赖使开始时固定的耦合每步一致，而改变的耦合于第 3 步不一致。

laws.en: The image of a process through a projection represents every finite path exactly, in the sense of GenerativeCore's projection_exact_iff, exactly where configurations alike under it match each other's steps up to it; some determined process on the description admits every step read through it and lifts each of its steps from every configuration of the fibre exactly where configurations alike go alike and match. Going alike does not give matching (Stuck); Coarse is exact through its first bit.
laws.zh: 过程经投影的像恰在经它相同的配置能在投影意义上相互匹配对方的步之处，按 GenerativeCore 的 projection_exact_iff 精确表示每条有限路径；某个描述上的确定过程容许经它读出的每一步，并从纤维中每个配置提升它的每一步，恰在相同的配置同去且匹配之处。同去不给出匹配（Stuck）；Coarse 经其第一位是精确的。

hypotheses.en: None beyond the run, the projection and the step before which its steps are read; the witnesses are two-configuration processes. No axiom.
hypotheses.zh: 运行、投影以及读到哪一步之外无；见证是两个配置的过程。不加公理。

hypotheses.en: For the backward direction, the relation is an equivalence; for coupling, the conditions are fixed (Conditions of Becoming.Renewal). The witness is a two-level process. No axiom.
hypotheses.zh: 对反方向，关系是等价关系；对耦合，条件是固定的（Becoming.Renewal 的 Conditions）。见证是两个水平的过程。不加公理。

hypotheses.en: Dependences are read off the configuration (Dependence of Becoming.Dependence); what a formation observes is fixed. For the criterion, the relation is the coupling, an equivalence. The witness is a one-level process. No axiom.
hypotheses.zh: 依赖从配置读出（Becoming.Dependence 的 Dependence）；形成所观察者固定。对判据，关系是耦合，一个等价关系。见证是一个水平的过程。不加公理。

does_not_show.en: Which projection an actual unfolding carries a law through, or that any formation forms or uses one.
does_not_show.zh: 实际展开经哪个投影承载规律，或任何形成形成或使用一个投影。

does_not_show.en: A law means a determined process; undetermined and random laws along a run are not treated.
does_not_show.zh: 规律指确定的过程；沿运行的不确定与随机规律没有处理。

does_not_show.en: The up-to form over histories (Web.AlikeThroughUpTo) relates two histories and is not the relation here.
does_not_show.zh: 对历史的到某步为止的形式（Web.AlikeThroughUpTo）关联两个历史，不是这里的关系。

does_not_show.en: Observation that changes along the run is not treated; what a formation observes is fixed, as in Becoming.Testing.
does_not_show.zh: 沿运行改变的观察没有处理；形成所观察者固定，如 Becoming.Testing。

does_not_show.en: A dependence not read off the configuration (a Web whose requirements change with the step alone) is not treated here.
does_not_show.zh: 不从配置读出的依赖（要求只随步改变的 Web）这里没有处理。

does_not_show.en: Which formation's coupling carries a law along an actual unfolding, or how many steps settle it.
does_not_show.zh: 实际展开中哪个形成的耦合承载规律，或要多少步才定下。

does_not_show.en: The criterion along one run is near-definitional: what it adds is the least candidate, the persistence of failure, the identity instance, the bridges to coupling and the comparison of fixed and changing coupling.
does_not_show.zh: 沿一个运行的判据近于定义：增量在于最小候选、失败的持续、恒等实例、通往耦合的桥，以及固定与改变的耦合之比较。

detail.en: A run consistent where the process has no law: Constant (Constant.consistent, Constant.not_goAlike). Going alike without exactness: Stuck (Stuck.goAlike_not_matches).
detail.zh: 运行一致而过程无规律：Constant（Constant.consistent、Constant.not_goAlike）。同去而不精确：Stuck（Stuck.goAlike_not_matches）。

detail.en: A determined process with no law at a formation's coupling along a run: Unseen (Unseen.determined, Unseen.no_law).
detail.zh: 确定的过程而沿运行在形成的耦合上无规律：Unseen（Unseen.determined、Unseen.no_law）。

detail.en: Neither law gives the other where dependences change: Changing (dissolving_consistent with dissolving_fixed_inconsistent; forming_fixed_consistent with forming_inconsistent).
detail.zh: 依赖改变之处两种规律互不给出：Changing（dissolving_consistent 与 dissolving_fixed_inconsistent；forming_fixed_consistent 与 forming_inconsistent）。

next_delta.en: How many steps of a run settle whether a law through a finite description or coupling holds (with Becoming.Recurrence); observation that changes along the run; an independent review.
next_delta.zh: 一个运行要多少步才定下经有限描述或耦合的规律是否成立（与 Becoming.Recurrence 一起）；沿运行改变的观察；独立审查。

correspondence.en: The chapter's open programme (section 8.2) named a constructive criterion along one run for a projection carrying a law, the bridge to GenerativeCore's exact projection, the instance with a formation's coupling as the relation, and the criterion through coupling that changes along the run; this record holds all four as one law under a relation with its readings, as the twentieth review's G4 asked. Coupling (Web.AlikeThrough) is a relation, not a projection, and an equality of what is coupled would need propext, so the law is stated up to an equivalence. Reading (the AI's): a run is evidence of a law under a relation exactly as far as its own steps agree; what it never visits it does not test; where what a formation does not couple into decides its next coupling, it meets no law at its coupling, only a record; a law at a description is not yet a faithful model of finite paths.
correspondence.zh: 本章开放纲领（第 8.2 节）列出沿一个运行、投影承载规律的构造性判据，通往 GenerativeCore 精确投影的桥，以形成的耦合为关系的实例，以及经沿运行改变的耦合的判据；本记录把四者作为关系之下的一条规律及其读法收在一起，如第二十次审查 G4 所求。耦合（Web.AlikeThrough）是关系而非投影，所耦合者的相等需要 propext，所以规律到等价关系为止陈述。读法（AI 的）：一个运行在多大程度上自身各步一致，就在多大程度上是关系之下规律的证据；它未到过的，它不检验；形成不耦合者决定其下一步耦合之处，它在其耦合上遇不到规律，只有记录；描述上的规律还不是有限路径的忠实模型。

detail.en: Reuses Image, factors_image, GoAlike, image_determined_iff, carries_law_iff, goAlike_const and the witnesses Coarse and Switching; the delta is the criterion along one run and exactness.
detail.zh: 复用 Image、factors_image、GoAlike、image_determined_iff、carries_law_iff、goAlike_const 以及见证 Coarse 与 Switching；增量是沿一个运行的判据与精确性。

output.en: A projection carrying a law over every configuration; the image as least candidate.
output.zh: 投影在一切配置上承载规律；像作为最小候选。

detail.zh: 复用 Dependence、Web.Forms、Web.Dissolves 与 Dependence.along：从配置读出的依赖，以及经它们读作 Web 的运行。

detail.en: There the record fixes a move's outcome only where taken; here the record read through a description is the least candidate law, a law exactly where it is consistent.
detail.zh: 那里记录只在动作被取处固定其结果；这里经描述读出的记录是最小的候选规律，恰在一致处是规律。

detail.en: There a difference below a threshold does not couple in; here a level outside what a formation couples into decides its next coupling along a run.
detail.zh: 那里阈值以下的差别不耦合入；这里形成所耦合者之外的水平沿运行决定其下一步的耦合。

claim.en: One law along a run, up to an equivalence: some process going alike under it admits a run's steps before a step exactly where any two of them alike under it, by the same move, end alike (Run.law_under_iff), with the record read under it as witness and failure persisting. Its readings are corollaries: through a projection, the relation of equal images (Run.ConsistentThrough is consistency under that relation, and Run.law_through_iff is proved from Run.law_under_iff), where the record is the least candidate and the identity gives the history law; through coupling that changes along the run, with dependences read off the configuration; and through fixed conditions, the instance whose dependences do not change, matching Web.AlikeThrough. Exactness of the image is a law of the whole process, kept beside them.
claim.zh: 沿一个运行、到等价关系为止的一条规律：某个在其下同去的过程容许一个运行在某步之前的各步，恰在其中任两步经它相同、以相同动作终于相同之处（Run.law_under_iff），见证是在其下读出的记录，失败持续。其读法都是推论：经投影，即像相等的关系（Run.ConsistentThrough 是此关系下的一致，Run.law_through_iff 由 Run.law_under_iff 证出），记录是最小候选，恒等给出历史之律；经沿运行改变的耦合，依赖从配置读出；经固定条件，即依赖不变的实例，与 Web.AlikeThrough 相合。像的精确是整个过程的规律，并列保留。
